description_en: Releases a subscription RDS Custom instance
description_zh: 调用DeleteRCInstance接口，释放一台或多台包年包月的RDS Custom实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds delete-rc-instances --instance-id rc-lrt4wdv22tr180f70000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRCInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully release a running instance. Valid values:

Yes
No (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制释放运行中的实例。取值范围：
Yes：强制
No（默认）：非强制
parameters.name: force

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release an expired subscription instance. Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.name: terminate_subscription

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, service limits, and insufficient inventory errors.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the instance is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次释放实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不释放实例。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接释放实例
parameters.name: dry_run
